studies.title: Documentation foundation
studies.question: Maintain navigable requirements, specifications and reproducibility guidance.
studies.finding: The documentation foundation exists; it is not evidence that later physical stages are accepted.
studies.next_action: Maintain traceability through the current register.
studies.exit_evidence: Navigable requirements and validated documentation.

studies.title: Repository layout and plan reconciliation
studies.question: Restore a single current roadmap without changing published evidence or scientific software.
studies.finding: This administrative package provides canonical stage indexes, stable study IDs and byte-preservation checks; local application and publication follow.
studies.next_action: Apply in a separate clone, review the documentation-only diff, then publish one administrative PR.
studies.exit_evidence: All baseline non-administrative paths/bytes/modes unchanged; all legacy report roots owned; current navigation generated from one register.

studies.title: Analytical Hopfion reference

studies.finding: Retained evidence supports only the scope stated in its original report. The administration change makes no new acceptance decision.
studies.next_action: Retain as a regression reference; revisit only through a new versioned study.
studies.exit_evidence: Original declared tolerances and applicability limits remain authoritative.

studies.title: Static neutral SF reference and recovered evidence
studies.question: Validate the declared SF energy and stationary references before stronger physical claims.
studies.finding: Recovered and partial static records remain intact. Reproduction and physical acceptance limits are unchanged.
studies.next_action: Retain these exact records and the complete-history source bundle as historical provenance.
studies.exit_evidence: Use the original report scopes; static stationarity does not establish charged particles or physical-time stability.

studies.title: Fresh Q22 numerical benchmark
studies.question: Assess fresh Q22 scalar and finite-diagram evidence.
studies.finding: PR48 records the fresh benchmark assessment; its finite topology and acceptance limits are preserved.
studies.next_action: Use as a declared static comparison, with its existing qualifications.
studies.exit_evidence: No additional topology or electron acceptance follows from this register.

studies.title: Q18 basin and Q17/Q19 static comparison
studies.question: Diagnose the Q18 alternative and compare neighbouring Q values without locking core knot type.
studies.finding: Q17/Q19 support the selected bounded K(7,2) branches. A Q18 linked outcome repeats; the target hyperbolic minimum remains unreproduced.
studies.next_action: Preserve all branches and return to fresh fine starts/conditioning after the dynamics tranche.
studies.exit_evidence: Fresh starts and conditioning are still needed before attributing the outcome solely to Q.

studies.title: Q18 fresh fine-start and conditioning follow-up
studies.question: Does start resolution or conditioning change the retained Q18 linked outcome?
studies.finding: This follow-up has not been completed; earlier unsuccessful hyperbolic reproduction is retained.
studies.next_action: Return after the low-Q/higher-Q dynamics tranche; predeclare independent starts, topology and energy comparisons.
studies.exit_evidence: Authenticated independent starts, preserved rejected outcomes, and controlled mesh/domain/conditioning comparisons.

studies.title: Additional-Q controls
studies.question: Do additional Q values clarify candidate selection beyond the Q18 difficulties?
studies.finding: Optional Q20/Q24 remain planned; no new run is claimed.
studies.next_action: Select a bounded comparison after Q18 follow-up; do not start an unbounded catalogue.
studies.exit_evidence: Same-action controls, fresh starts and preserved topology/energy comparisons.

studies.title: Neutral dynamics admission
studies.question: Are retained static fields numerically suitable inputs to the declared neutral dynamics?
studies.finding: 31 endpoints were assessed; sampled curvature was positive, with significant finite-domain stress sensitivity. No physical-time evolution was established by admission alone.
studies.next_action: Retain admission findings as input qualifications for motion studies.
studies.exit_evidence: Full stability and isolated-boundary acceptance remain separate.

studies.title: Physical-time solver and independent renderer controls
studies.question: Validate the time solver independently and keep renderer sampling separate from science.
studies.finding: Wave/manufactured controls, checkpoint/resume and export invariance are recorded. An animation is not physical acceptance.
studies.next_action: Preserve the reference controls and renderer contract during future initializer work.
studies.exit_evidence: Scientific grid, precision and integration remain independent of optional display exports.

studies.title: Low-Q physical-time campaign
studies.question: Do readmitted Q1/Q2 fields support controlled bounded motion under the unchanged action?
studies.finding: 6 rest states and 60 cases completed. Six bounded passes remain; 50 tail, 18 shape and four momentum failures overlap. General motion acceptance is open.
studies.next_action: Use retained full fields for diagnosis before a new production matrix.
studies.exit_evidence: Existing tolerances and failed cases remain authoritative; no isolated long-time stability claim.

studies.title: Full-field motion diagnostics
studies.question: Separate timestep, initialization, mesh/domain and classical kinetic-metric effects in retained fields.
studies.finding: PR54 records zero mismatch in 540 endpoint comparisons, six rest metrics and 70 pairs. Initialization and domain sensitivity persist; inertia is not converged.
studies.next_action: Proceed to initialization and consistently registered initial/comoving comparisons.
studies.exit_evidence: Compact record integrity is confirmed; full fields remain local. Sampling grids do not replace physical resolutions.

studies.title: Boost initialization and field registration
studies.question: Can a smoother, consistently differentiated reconstruction improve boost consistency without changing the action?
studies.finding: The diagnostic finds 5.99–10.98% internal-field-rate mismatch. This is not centroid speed error and does not prove interpolation explains all shape error.
studies.next_action: Start with retained fields and independent analytical controls at exact nodes, shifted points and boundary extensions. Compare old and new variants; add phase-invariant, initial-state and comoving-residual comparisons.
studies.exit_evidence: Document the interpolant and its derivatives, normalization/tangency, independent accuracy/order and preserved old reference. Do not replace velocity with a fitted D4 derivative merely to erase the residual. Register field symmetries consistently without hiding x/z dependence.

studies.title: Focused motion, mesh and domain convergence
studies.question: Which residuals survive improved initialization, a third physical mesh and a larger matched-spacing box?
studies.finding: No new production run is claimed. Q1 tail and inertia remain domain-sensitive; Q2 low-speed results are provisional bounded references.
studies.next_action: After the initializer decision, run a small beta=.3 x/z comparison before selecting third-h and larger-Q1-box controls. Preserve action, precision and predeclared gates.
studies.exit_evidence: Separate starting-state, temporal, spatial and domain effects; quantify tails, momentum, shape and inertia. A tail pass alone does not validate inertia or isolation.

studies.title: Q17/Q19 motion comparison
studies.question: Do selected higher-Q static references retain controlled motion once low-Q methods are adequately validated?
studies.finding: Static K(7,2) identification is not a motion or electron-model result.
studies.next_action: Proceed conditionally after adequate low-Q control with matched physical resolution, domain and observation-window checks.
studies.exit_evidence: Authenticated higher-Q initial states, conservation, localization, topology and convergence within explicitly bounded scope.

studies.title: Charged-model equation audit
studies.question: Does the proposed charged extension provide general Maxwell equivalence and unrestricted causal evolution?
studies.finding: The retained audit records finite energy/charge-flux checks and unresolved equivalence/degeneracy issues; charged dynamics is deferred.
studies.next_action: Retain the counterexamples and exact algebra. Resolve feasibility before a charged simulation.
studies.exit_evidence: No charged dynamics or electron acceptance from the analytical audit alone.

studies.title: Charged-theory feasibility follow-up
studies.question: Can a justified extension resolve the audited causal/constraint/coupling gaps?
studies.finding: No replacement charged model has been accepted. Analytic feasibility can be examined in parallel without launching charged dynamics.
studies.next_action: Specify altered assumptions and derive constraints, hyperbolicity and observable coupling before implementation.
studies.exit_evidence: Source-mapped equations and independently checked admissibility/coupling; distinguish supplied charge laws from emergence.

studies.title: External-field and interaction benchmarks
studies.question: Can a validated candidate respond to independently specified probes under a justified coupling?
studies.finding: Uniform/nonuniform-field, pair-interaction and apparatus ideas remain conditional; no force law is inferred from visualization.
studies.next_action: First select coupling and apparatus assumptions; predeclare force, energy/momentum and orientation observables.
studies.exit_evidence: Converged probes and controls without fitting the desired charge law into the model.

studies.title: Q1/Q2 symmetry and spin-method controls
studies.question: Can converged kinetic metrics and configuration-space symmetry support an explicitly qualified collective-coordinate treatment?
studies.finding: Measured classical Gram matrices have near-dependent axial/phase directions and finite-domain sensitivity. No quantum spin has been derived.
studies.next_action: Establish metric and symmetry limits before eliminating coordinates or inverting a reduced metric; map appropriate loops and explicitly stated quantization assumptions.
studies.exit_evidence: Independent symmetry/loop controls, qualified FR applicability, and no conflation of imposed quantization with classical emergence.

studies.title: Stern–Gerlach and detector benchmarks
studies.question: Does a justified model predict apparatus outcomes beyond classical deflection or imposed two-state assumptions?
studies.finding: No Stern–Gerlach, detector-probability or electron acceptance follows from current neutral motion.
studies.next_action: After candidate/coupling and state-preparation controls, specify the apparatus and distinguish emergent outcomes from supplied quantum rules.
studies.exit_evidence: Independent experimental observables, orientation/sequential controls, probability law and uncertainty with assumptions exposed.

studies.title: Wavefunction and energy-density observable comparison
studies.question: Which model observables can be meaningfully compared with a wavefunction position distribution?
studies.finding: A deterministic energy density is not automatically a probability distribution; no Born-rule equivalence is accepted.
studies.next_action: Define preparation, observable map and ensemble or measurement law explicitly before using distributions to select candidates.
studies.exit_evidence: Compare declared predictions and controls, not visually similar density plots; identify fitted inputs and independently tested outputs.
